source.name: Air Ventilation Assessment for the Development of Hung Shui Kiu Area 13 (AVRG73)
source.publisher: Planning Department / Civil Engineering and Development Department
source.criteriaSource: Technical Circular No. 1/06 - Air Ventilation Assessment, and Annex A 'Technical Guide for Air Ventilation Assessment for Developments in Hong Kong', issued 19 July 2006

definition.velocityRatio: VR = Vp / V-inf, where Vp is wind speed at pedestrian level and V-inf is wind speed at the top of the wind boundary layer, taken as about 596 m above the centre of the site of concern.
definition.direction: High VR means LESS impact from the development, i.e. better ventilation.

windRegime.note: Stated by the report as the most dominant wind directions for this site. This is the one published wind-rose fact we use; no other direction is assigned a frequency.

publishedVelocityRatios.method: Computational fluid dynamics in the source report. We do not run CFD.

effectiveDesignMeasures: Podium-free design, for wind penetration under the building
Dedicated wind corridors along the prevailing wind directions
whatThisIsNot: These velocity ratios are the source report's CFD results for its own baseline and proposed schemes. They are NOT measurements of the current Hung Shui Kiu / Ha Tsuen street layout and they are NOT our model's output.
A frontal area density computed from building geometry is a screening proxy and is NOT a velocity ratio. The two are not interchangeable and must never be reported as the same number.
The pass/fail bands live in Technical Circular 1/06 and its Annex A Technical Guide, which we have not extracted. No threshold is asserted here.
